info.name: Khaokong API — Complete Test Collection
info.description: Postman collection for the Khaokong Node.js/Express API. Import the companion environment, set owner credentials, run Login first, then run create requests to populate customerId/orderId/riderId/planId/jobCode/stopId/trackingCode. Destructive cleanup requests are labeled; run them only against test data.

exec: const token = pm.response.json().data?.token; if (token) pm.environment.set("accessToken", token); pm.test("Login returns a token", () => pm.expect(token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty);
const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data?.id != null) pm.environment.set("customerId", String(data.id));

item.name: Delete customer by ID (test record only)

request.description: Deletes the customer created by this collection. Remove its orders first if you created any.

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data?.id != null) pm.environment.set("riderId", String(data.id));

item.name: Delete rider by ID (test record only)

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data?.id != null) pm.environment.set("orderId", String(data.id)); if (data?.trackingCode) pm.environment.set("trackingCode", data.trackingCode);

item.name: Change order box count by delta

request.description: Deletes only simulated orders for the selected date; may also remove plans that reference those orders.

item.name: Create draft plan (saves planId, routeId, jobCode, stopId)

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data?.id != null) pm.environment.set("planId", String(data.id)); const route = data?.routes?.[0]; if (route?.id != null) pm.environment.set("routeId", String(route.id)); if (route?.jobCode) pm.environment.set("jobCode", route.jobCode); const stop = route?.stops?.[0]; if (stop?.id != null) pm.environment.set("stopId", String(stop.id));

const data = pm.response.json().data?.plan; if (data?.id != null) pm.environment.set("planId", String(data.id)); const route = data?.routes?.[0]; if (route?.id != null) pm.environment.set("routeId", String(route.id)); if (route?.jobCode) pm.environment.set("jobCode", route.jobCode); const stop = route?.stops?.[0]; if (stop?.id != null) pm.environment.set("stopId", String(stop.id));

request.description: Confirms and locks the plan orders. Run only after preview/review and rider assignment.
Cancels a confirmed plan and releases its orders.
Only removes a non-active plan. A confirmed plan must be cancelled first.
Deletes only simulated orders for this date.
Deletes simulated customers that are not referenced by orders.
Destructive cleanup of simulated data only. Set includeRiders=true only if you also want to remove simulated riders.
